title: Imputing synthetic expression arrays
description: Mask known synthetic expression values and compare actual held-out RMSE and original-style NRMSE.

reproduction.method: Row/column means, shared-coordinate kNN, and iterative rank-2 PCA completion
reproduction.description: Mask known synthetic expression values and compare actual held-out RMSE and original-style NRMSE.
differences: Seeded synthetic data, not measurements from the named original benchmark.
84×12 low-rank profiles and 10%/25% MCAR missingness replace yeast stress/cell-cycle arrays, 1%/10% missingness and repeated trials.
Iterative PCA completion is an explicit substitute for mixGauss1 conditional imputation; no Gaussian-mixture EM claim.
Single seeded masks and bar charts replace repeated-trial boxplots; nondeterministic wall-clock timing is intentionally not reported.

checks.name: Only masked entries are changed by all five imputers
Low-rank completion beats column means at both missingness levels
kNN captures similarity beyond column means
Both masks contain nontrivial held-out entries
